reports.title: Ley del Sistema Nacional de Información Estadística y Geográfica (LSNIEG)
reports.publisher: Congreso de la Unión / Estados Unidos Mexicanos
reports.description: Foundational 2008 statute (with subsequent reforms) that creates the autonomous INEGI and the entire Sistema Nacional de Información Estadística y Geográfica (SNIEG). It is the permanent legal basis for virtually all official Mexican statistics and is cited recurringly in methodology documents, publication calendars, and institutional descriptions as the source of INEGI’s mandate and of ‘Información de Interés Nacional’.

_variants.description: Foundational 2008 statute (last major reform DOF 14-11-2025) that creates the autonomous INEGI and the entire Sistema Nacional de Información Estadística y Geográfica (SNIEG). Regulates Information of National Interest, the rights/obligations of informants, and INEGI’s organisation and powers. Static instrument with no independent publication cadence of its own.
_variants.notes:
Classic pure recurring-citation node under the new rule. Every major INEGI methodology synthesis opens by grounding itself in this Law.

Contextual quote from Censo Agropecuario 2022 methodology (INEGI):
"El Instituto Nacional de Estadística y Geografía (INEGI), con el propósito de ofrecer estadísticas actuales, completas y oportunas de las actividades agropecuarias y forestales en México y con fundamento en las atribuciones que le confiere la Ley del Sistema Nacional de Información Estadística y Geográfica (LSNIEG), realizó el Censo Agropecuario 2022. El presente documento es una síntesis metodológica que da sustento y transparencia a los procedimientos conceptuales, operativos, de procesamiento, análisis de datos y difusión de resultados..."

Contextual quote from Censo de Población y Vivienda 2010 Síntesis metodológica:
"El Instituto Nacional de Estadística y Geografía (INEGI), con fundamento en lo dispuesto por la Constitución Política de los Estados Unidos Mexicanos en su Artículo 26, apartado B, y en el ejercicio de las atribuciones que la Ley del Sistema Nacional de Información Estadística y Geográfica le confiere, realizó el Censo de Población y Vivienda 2010. ... Bases legales. Para la generación de información estadística y geográfica, el INEGI se rige por lo dispuesto en la Ley del Sistema Nacional de Información Estadística y Geográfica (Ley del SNIEG) que tiene fundamento en lo dispuesto en el artículo 26, apartado B de la Constitución Política de los Estados Unidos Mexicanos."

The Law itself states (Art. 1): it is of public order, social interest and general observance throughout the Republic, and has as its object the regulation of the SNIEG, the rights and obligations of Informants, the organisation and functioning of INEGI, and administrative offences.

reports.title: Índice Nacional de Precios al Consumidor (INPC) / Consumer Price Index
reports.description: Core inflation measure. Published twice monthly (10th and 25th) in the Official Journal. Basket and weights updated periodically (most recent major update 2024 based on ENIGH 2022) while maintaining the 2nd half of July 2018 base.

_variants.description: Primary consumer price index. Base second half of July 2018 = 100. Basket and weights updated 2024 using ENIGH 2022 Seasonal while preserving the base via chaining. Published twice monthly (around the 10th and 25th) in the Official Journal of the Federation. Transferred from Banco de México to INEGI under the LSNIEG effective July 2011.
_variants.notes:
High-frequency, high-authority series. Legal transfer is explicitly documented.

Contextual quote from INEGI INPC programme page:
"From its beginnings until June 2011, the Price Indexes were calculated by Mexico's Central Bank, however, with the entry into force of the Law of the National System of Statistical and Geographical Information, the exclusive power for the elaboration of these macroeconomic indicators was granted to the National Institute of Statistics and Geography (INEGI), so that as of July 15th, 2011, the Institute periodically and systematically quotes, analyzes, calculates and publishes the CPI and PPI indexes."

Publication practice: "The CPI is published on the 10th and 25th of each month in the Official Journal of the Federation, or on the previous working day in case these dates are Saturday, Sunday or holiday. On the 25th of the month, the calculation of the first half of the month is published, on the 10th, the one corresponding to the monthly data and the second half of the previous month is published."

reports.title: Sistema de Cuentas Nacionales de México (SCNM) / System of National Accounts of Mexico
reports.description: Mexico’s national accounts system (annual + quarterly + monthly indicators). Explicitly follows SNA 2008. Includes Supply and Use Tables, institutional sector accounts, and multiple satellite accounts. Base year currently 2018 for many series (previous major bases 2013 and 2008).

_variants.description: Mexico’s integrated national accounts framework following SNA 2008. Includes annual and quarterly estimates, Supply and Use Tables, institutional sector accounts, satellite accounts (culture, health, non-profit, unpaid household work, tourism, etc.), and related short-term indicators. Current major base years include 2018 and earlier 2013/2008 benchmarks.
_variants.notes:
Central macroeconomic framework. Explicitly adopts SNA 2008.

Contextual material from INEGI methodology documents (SCNM base 2008 series): the calculations adopt and adapt the conceptual and accounting framework of the System of National Accounts approved by the United Nations Statistical Commission for 1968, 1993 and 2008, together with specific manuals. Annual calculations with base year 2008 produce the current and accumulation accounts recommended by SNA 2008 (goods and services accounts, institutional sector accounts, public-sector macroeconomic indicators, etc.).

IMF ROSC (2021) confirms: "The methodology followed is consistent with the System of National Accounts 2008 and the IMF’s Quarterly National Accounts Manual 2017."

reports._notes: Central macroeconomic framework. Strong links both to the domestic legal foundation and to the international SNA 2008 standard.
reports._why_qualifies: Mexico’s national accounts system (annual + quarterly + monthly indicators). Explicitly follows SNA 2008. Includes Supply and Use Tables, institutional sector accounts, and multiple satellite accounts. Base year currently 2018 for many series (previous major bases 2013 and 2008).
reports._url_evidence: Retrieved and read: 'Sistema de Cuentas Nacionales de Mexico. Guia rapida. Ano base 2018', published by INEGI. reports._notes: High-frequency industrial series. Companion state-level series IMAIEF (Indicador Mensual de la Actividad Industrial por Entidad Federativa) also exists and is published by INEGI.

reports.title: Encuesta Nacional de Ingresos y Gastos de los Hogares (ENIGH) / National Survey of Household Income and Expenditure
reports.description: Household income and expenditure survey. Primary source for the structure of household consumption used in CPI basket and weight updates (most recent major INPC update 2024 drew on Seasonal ENIGH 2022). Also central for poverty and distribution analysis.
reports._notes: Direct documented input into the 2024 INPC basket and weights update. Contextual link from INEGI INPC documentation: the update of the Basket and Structure of weighting of the Consumer Price Index was based on information of the Seasonal ENIGH 2022, maintaining the base while applying chaining methodology.

reports.title: Estadística de Finanzas Públicas Estatales y Municipales (EFIPEM) / State and Municipal Public Finances Statistics
reports.description: Annual (and now also quarterly for states) statistics of revenues and expenditures of state governments, the government of Mexico City, municipalities and alcaldías. Provides the principal comparable picture of sub-national public finances. Geographic coverage: 32 entities + municipalities/alcaldías. Time series from the late 1980s/1990s onward with methodological synthesis documents.
reports._notes:
Critical bridge node for state and municipal jurisdiction levels. INEGI aggregates and standardises the data; the underlying reporting comes from the entities themselves.

From INEGI programme description: "Información referente a los ingresos y egresos anuales de los Gobiernos de Estados, Municipios, Ciudad de México y Alcaldías con el fin de mostrar su comportamiento en el ámbito económico y social, contribuyendo a la transparencia de la acción pública..."

A Síntesis Metodológica is published (e.g. EFIPEM 2025 / 2026 edition covering 2024 data). From March 2026 INEGI also began publishing quarterly state public-finance figures (EFIPET) using internationally recommended classifications.

This series is the practical way most sub-national fiscal data enter the national statistical system and downstream analyses.

reports.title: Objetivo para la Tasa de Interés Interbancaria a un día (Tasa Objetivo) / Overnight Interbank Funding Rate Target
reports.description: Primary monetary-policy instrument of Banco de México. The Governing Board announces the target for the overnight interbank funding rate according to a published calendar of monetary-policy decisions. Decisions are published as press releases; minutes follow later. The rate is the main operational target used to influence the yield curve, exchange rate and inflation expectations.
reports._notes:
Central-bank policy rate. Published on a pre-announced calendar (typically eight decisions per year). Recent examples (2026): decisions keeping the target at 6.50 % (August, June) or adjusting it by 25 bp steps earlier in the easing cycle.

Contextual quote from a typical announcement (5 Feb 2026 style):
"La Junta de Gobierno del Banco de México decidió mantener el objetivo para la Tasa de Interés Interbancaria a un día en 7.00%. ... Así, la Junta de Gobierno, con la presencia de todos sus miembros, decidió por unanimidad mantener el objetivo para la Tasa de Interés Interbancaria a un día en 7.00%."

The rate is referenced throughout Banxico quarterly reports and is the instrument through which monetary policy is described as transmitting to the real economy and prices.

reports.title: Informe Trimestral / Quarterly Report (Banco de México)
reports.description: Quarterly report of Banco de México on inflation, economic activity, monetary policy and the outlook. Published according to a fixed calendar. Contains the Board’s assessment of the inflationary environment and the rationale for the policy-rate path.
reports._notes: Regular analytical publication that both uses and interprets INEGI price and activity data and explains the setting of the tasa objetivo. Full text, summary and presentation are released together. Serves as a documented link between Banxico’s policy rate and the broader statistical system (INEGI CPI, activity indicators, etc.).

reports.title: Balanza Comercial de Mercancías de México / Merchandise Trade Balance
reports.description: Monthly merchandise trade balance statistics. Methodological synthesis documents are published. Forms part of the external-sector information used in balance-of-payments and national-accounts work.
reports._notes: High-frequency trade series. Síntesis metodológica documents exist (e.g. 2026 edition). Used as an input into broader external and national-accounts frameworks; Banxico and other users routinely cite the merchandise trade figures.

reports.title: Estadística Educativa del Sistema Educativo Nacional (Formato 911 / SIGED) / National Education Statistics
reports.publisher: Secretaría de Educación Pública (SEP) — Dirección General de Planeación, Programación y Estadística Educativa
reports.description: Official continuous education statistics of the National Education System. Captured each school year via Formato 911 through the Sistema de Información y Gestión Educativa (SIGED). Covers enrolment (alumnos), teachers (docentes) and schools (escuelas) by level, modality, sustained public/private, and entity. Principal indicators (coverage, net enrolment rates, terminal efficiency, dropout, etc.) are published nationally and by state.
reports._notes: Core education statistical system. SEP integrates the data; INEGI also disseminates related tabulations. Publications such as ‘Estadística e indicadores educativos por entidad federativa’ (cycle 2024-2025 and earlier) provide the official national and state figures. Historical series extend back many decades. This is the primary recurrent source for education counts and indicators used in planning and evaluation.

reports.title: Censo de Escuelas, Maestros y Alumnos de Educación Básica y Especial (CEMABE) / Census of Schools, Teachers and Students of Basic and Special Education
reports.description: One-time (2013) comprehensive census of basic and special education schools, teachers and students, ordered as part of the 2012–13 education reform to create a reliable Sistema de Información y Gestión Educativa. Provides detailed infrastructure, staffing and student data that continuous Formato 911 statistics build upon.
reports._notes: Static foundational census for the modern education information system. Even though conducted once, it remains the reference point for the continuous education statistics architecture and is cited when describing the origin of the current SIGED / Formato 911 system. Qualifies under the expanded rule via recurring institutional citation.
_referenced_by: Subsequent education planning and SIGED development
SEP statistical publications that still reference the 2013 census baseline for infrastructure and staffing

reports.title: Encuesta Nacional de Salud y Nutrición (ENSANUT / Ensanut Continua) / National Health and Nutrition Survey
reports.publisher: Instituto Nacional de Salud Pública (INSP) / Secretaría de Salud
reports.description: Flagship health and nutrition survey. Originally periodic; now run as Ensanut Continua with annual fieldwork to support more timely and eventually state-level estimates. Covers health status, nutrition, service utilisation, vaccination, risk factors, and specialised modules (e.g. mental health, lead exposure, cardiovascular). Results used for public-health policy and as a complement to administrative health data.
reports._notes: Primary population health survey. 2026 wave planned for ~12 000 households with expanded modules. Provides the main survey-based picture of health-service use (public vs private), out-of-pocket burden context, and nutritional status. Complements the administrative and satellite-account health statistics.

reports.title: Cuenta Satélite del Sector Salud de México (CSSSM) / Satellite Account of the Health Sector of Mexico
reports.description: Satellite account that measures the economic size of the health sector within the SCNM framework. Reports health-sector GDP, employment, and the contribution of household spending and unpaid health-related work. Consistent with national-accounts concepts and updated annually.
reports._notes: Key link between health and the national accounts. 2024 results (published 2025): health-sector GDP ~1.75 trillion pesos (5.2% of total GDP); ~2.2 million paid jobs; household contributions (direct spending + unpaid work) exceeding 1.1 trillion pesos. Provides the macroeconomic counterpart to the survey and administrative health data.

reports.title: ENIGH — Gasto de los hogares en cuidados de la salud / Household health expenditure (from ENIGH)
reports.description: Component of the Encuesta Nacional de Ingresos y Gastos de los Hogares that measures out-of-pocket health spending by households. Used to track catastrophic health expenditure, impoverishment due to health costs, and the distribution of the health-financing burden.
reports._notes: Critical for ‘medical transfers’ and financial-protection analysis. 2024 ENIGH results show average quarterly household health spending rising in real terms; analyses (México Evalúa, CIEP) document increases in catastrophic health expenditure and the regressive burden on lower-income deciles. Complements the CSSSM (which also records household health spending) and ENSANUT (service utilisation).

reports.title: Encuesta Nacional de Calidad e Impacto Gubernamental (ENCIG) / National Survey of Governmental Quality and Impact
reports.description: Survey of the population aged 18+ in cities of 100 000+ inhabitants on experiences and perceptions of public procedures and services provided by different levels of government (including security and justice). Measures satisfaction with basic public services (water, sewage, street lighting, garbage collection, police, roads, parks, etc.) and on-demand services, as well as corruption incidence and institutional trust.
reports._notes: Primary instrument for public-service quality and user experience at municipal and higher levels. 2025 results: overall satisfaction with basic and on-demand public services 47.2%; detailed satisfaction rates for garbage collection (71.5%), drinking water (51.4%), drainage (43.4%), street lighting (41.1%), police (27.9%), etc. Also captures corruption experience and perception. Directly relevant to municipal and state service delivery evaluation.

reports.title: Encuesta Mensual de la Industria Manufacturera (EMIM) / Monthly Survey of the Manufacturing Industry
reports.description: Monthly establishment survey of manufacturing activity. Produces indicators of production, employed personnel, hours worked and real average remuneration. Core high-frequency input into the Indicador Mensual de la Actividad Industrial (IMAI) and national accounts.
reports._notes: Primary monthly manufacturing survey. Explicitly listed among the main sources of the IMAI (together with ENEC, mining statistics and ENOE). Regular bulletins publish month-on-month and year-on-year changes in production, employment, hours and wages.

reports.title: Encuesta Mensual sobre Empresas Comerciales (EMEC) / Monthly Survey of Commercial Enterprises
reports.description: Monthly survey of wholesale and retail commercial enterprises. Tracks real income from supply of goods and services, employed personnel, remunerations and related variables at national and state level. Operating continuously since the 1980s (originally Mexico City metro area, later national).
reports._notes: Key high-frequency commerce indicator. Sample covers thousands of commercial enterprises; results published monthly with seasonally adjusted series for wholesale and retail. Direct input into short-term economic monitoring and national-accounts compilation.

reports.title: Encuesta Mensual de Servicios (EMS) / Monthly Survey of Services
reports.description: Monthly survey of private non-financial services (including transport, storage and related activities). Produces indicators of real income, employment, expenses and remunerations at national and state level.
reports._notes: Completes the trio of high-frequency establishment surveys (manufacturing, commerce, services) that feed short-term activity indicators and the national accounts.

reports.title: Encuesta Nacional de Empresas Constructoras (ENEC) / National Survey of Construction Companies
reports.description: Monthly survey of construction enterprises. Measures the evolution of construction activity and is one of the principal statistical sources used in the compilation of the Indicador Mensual de la Actividad Industrial (IMAI) for the construction sector.
reports._notes: Documented source for the construction component of IMAI. Methodology notes for IMAI list ENEC together with EMIM, mining statistics and ENOE as main inputs.

reports.title: Líneas de Pobreza por Ingresos (LPI / LPEI) / Income Poverty Lines
reports.description: Monetary poverty lines (urban and rural) representing the monthly cost of the food basket (extreme poverty line) and the food + non-food basic basket (poverty line). Updated monthly using the INPC. Used as the income threshold in Mexico’s multidimensional poverty measurement.
reports._notes: High-frequency social indicator. Values are updated with the INPC; July 2026 urban LPI was reported around 4 884 pesos per person per month. Forms the economic-wellbeing dimension of the official multidimensional poverty measure. After institutional changes, INEGI has taken a larger direct role in the poverty measurement and line updates.

reports.title: Medición Multidimensional de la Pobreza / Multidimensional Poverty Measurement
reports.publisher: INEGI (methodology originally developed under CONEVAL / Ley General de Desarrollo Social)
reports.description: Official multidimensional poverty measure. A person is in poverty when income is below the poverty line and at least one of six social-rights deprivations is present (education, health services, social security, housing quality/spaces, basic housing services, food). Extreme poverty combines income below the extreme line with more severe deprivation. Results published periodically (often aligned with ENIGH cycles).
reports._notes: Central social-policy indicator. Relies on ENIGH (and related modules) for income and deprivation data and on the income poverty lines. Recent figures (around 2024 measurement) indicate substantial reductions in both income poverty and multidimensional poverty relative to 2018. The underlying methodology document remains a key static reference that is cited every measurement cycle.

reports.title: Cuenta Satélite del Turismo de México (CSTM) / Satellite Account of Tourism of Mexico
reports.description: Satellite account measuring the economic contribution of tourism within the SCNM framework. Reports tourism GDP, employment in tourism activities, and detailed breakdowns by characteristic tourism products and activities. Base year currently 2018.
reports._notes: 2024 results: tourism GDP ≈ 2.71 trillion pesos (8.7% of total economy); ≈ 2.9 million paid jobs (7.4% of national total). Constructed from the Supply and Use Tables, Input-Output Matrix and Goods-and-Services accounts of the SCNM.

reports.title: Cuenta Satélite del Trabajo No Remunerado de los Hogares de México (CSTNRHM) / Satellite Account of Unpaid Household Work
reports.description: Satellite account that assigns an economic value to unpaid domestic and care work performed by household members. Complements the conventional GDP by making visible a large volume of work that falls outside market production boundaries.
reports._notes: 2024 results: economic value of unpaid domestic and care work ≈ 8 trillion pesos — larger than manufacturing or commerce as a share of conventional GDP. Women account for the majority of the hours and value. Provides the macroeconomic counterpart to time-use and care-economy analysis and links to the health satellite account’s unpaid-work component.

reports.title: Encuesta Nacional de Victimización y Percepción sobre Seguridad Pública (ENVIPE)
reports.description: Annual household survey estimating crime prevalence, incidence, dark figure (cifra negra), characteristics of victims and crimes, economic and social impact of crime, perception of public security, and trust/performance of security and justice institutions. National and state representativeness. Part of the SNIGSPIJ.
reports._notes: Flagship victimization survey (15th edition in 2025 covering 2024). 2025 results: 29.0% of households had at least one member who was a crime victim; 23.1 million people aged 18+ victimized. Measures trust in Marina, Army, Guardia Nacional, state and municipal police, etc. Explicitly framed as Información de Interés Nacional within the government/security/justice subsystem of the SNIEG.

reports.title: Encuesta Nacional de Seguridad Pública Urbana (ENSU) / National Survey of Urban Public Security
reports.description: Quarterly survey of perception of insecurity and related behaviours in selected urban areas (expanded set of cities). Complements ENVIPE with higher-frequency urban perception indicators, expectations about crime, and evaluation of security authorities.
reports._notes: High-frequency companion to ENVIPE. June 2026 results showed perception of insecurity at 59.8% among adults in the covered urban areas. Tracks evaluation of Marina, Army, municipal police, etc., and household victimization of selected crimes in the reference semester.

reports.title: Indicador Trimestral de la Actividad Económica Estatal (ITAEE) / Quarterly Indicator of State Economic Activity
reports.description: Quarterly volume index of economic activity for each of the 32 federal entities. Part of the Sistema de Cuentas Nacionales de México. Provides the main short-term picture of state-level GDP-like activity.
reports._notes: Core state-level activity indicator (base 2018). Published with seasonally adjusted and original series; ranks entities by quarterly and annual growth. Direct bridge from national SCNM to the state jurisdiction level.

reports.title: Exportaciones Trimestrales por Entidad Federativa (ETEF) / Quarterly Exports by Federal Entity
reports.description: Quarterly value of merchandise exports by federal entity (and by SCIAN sector/subsector). Shows each state’s contribution to Mexico’s external trade.
reports._notes: Important regional trade series. Q1 2026 total ≈ USD 158 billion; Chihuahua, Jalisco, Coahuila, Nuevo León and Baja California typically dominate. Complements the national Balanza Comercial and links state activity to external demand (and indirectly to T-MEC utilisation patterns).

reports.title: Directorio Estadístico Nacional de Unidades Económicas (DENUE) / National Statistical Directory of Economic Units
reports.description: Statistical directory of economic units (establishments) with location, activity (SCIAN), size and other identifying variables. Updated periodically; used as sampling frame and public business-location resource. Methodological documents accompany each major update.
reports._notes: Foundational business-frame product. Supports design of establishment surveys (EMIM, EMEC, EMS, ENEC, etc.) and is itself a disseminated statistical product with methodological documentation (e.g. 2026 update).

reports.title: Puestos de trabajo afiliados al IMSS / IMSS-affiliated employment posts
reports.description: Monthly administrative statistics of formal private-sector employment posts registered with the Mexican Social Security Institute. Reports permanent and temporary posts, average contribution wage, and employer registrations. Principal high-frequency indicator of formal private employment.
reports._notes: Key formal-employment series. Mid-2026 figures around 22.8 million posts (majority permanent). Widely used alongside ENOE (which covers total employment including informal) to monitor labour-market formalisation. Average contribution wage also published.

reports.title: Anuario Estadístico del ISSSTE / ISSSTE Statistical Yearbook
reports.publisher: Instituto de Seguridad y Servicios Sociales de los Trabajadores del Estado (ISSSTE)
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook of the social-security institute covering public-sector workers. Includes population with entitlement (derechohabientes), pensions by type and regime, medical services and other benefits, with state detail.
reports._notes: Main published statistical product for ISSSTE coverage and pensions. Complements IMSS data for a fuller picture of formal social-security affiliation (private vs public-sector workers).

reports.title: Pensión para el Bienestar de las Personas Adultas Mayores
reports.publisher: Secretaría del Bienestar / Gobierno de México
reports.description: Universal (or near-universal) non-contributory pension for older adults. One of the largest social-transfer programmes. Coverage and payment statistics are published in official programme reports and inform poverty and income analyses.
reports._notes: Major medical/social transfer programme. 2025 reporting indicated ~13.2 million older-adult beneficiaries with multi-hundred-billion-peso annual outlays. Directly relevant to household income, poverty reduction, and the ‘medical transfers / social protection’ theme. Complements contributory pensions (IMSS/ISSSTE) and ENIGH income data.

reports.title: Pensión Mujeres Bienestar
reports.publisher: Secretaría del Bienestar / Gobierno de México
reports.description: Targeted non-contributory pension / support programme for women (specific age and eligibility rules). Coverage statistics published in Bienestar programme reports.
reports._notes: Significant gender-focused transfer. 2025 figures cited ~3.0 million women beneficiaries. Part of the broader Bienestar transfer architecture that feeds into household income and poverty analysis.

reports.title: Pensión para el Bienestar de las Personas con Discapacidad
reports.publisher: Secretaría del Bienestar / Gobierno de México
reports.description: Non-contributory disability support programme with universal coverage in a large set of states. Beneficiary counts published in official programme reporting.
reports._notes: Completes the core trio of large Bienestar cash-transfer programmes (older adults, women, disability). 2025 coverage figures in the 1.6 million range. Relevant to social-protection and poverty analysis alongside ENIGH and multidimensional poverty measurement.

reports.title: Indicador Mensual de la Actividad Industrial por Entidad Federativa (IMAIEF)
reports.description: Monthly industrial activity indicator disaggregated by federal entity. Companion to the national IMAI; allows state-level tracking of mining, manufacturing, construction and utilities.
reports._notes: State-level monthly industrial series. Extends the national IMAI framework to the entity level and is published on the regular INEGI calendar.

reports.title: ENOE — Tasa de informalidad laboral / Labour informality rate (from ENOE)
reports.description: Key labour-market indicator derived from the Encuesta Nacional de Ocupación y Empleo measuring the share of employed persons in informal employment. Published with the regular ENOE releases.
reports._notes: Critical complement to formal-employment series (IMSS). Recent figures hover near 55% informality. Used in national-accounts informal-sector estimation and in social-policy analysis. Treated as a distinct high-value indicator node even though it is produced from ENOE microdata.

reports.title: Cuentas por Sectores Institucionales (SCNM) / Institutional Sector Accounts
reports.description: Annual institutional-sector accounts within the Sistema de Cuentas Nacionales de México (non-financial corporations, financial corporations, general government, households, non-profit institutions serving households, rest of the world). Provide the full sequence of current and accumulation accounts by sector.
reports._notes: Detailed layer of the SCNM. Explicitly listed in methodology documents as part of the accounts produced under SNA 2008. Essential for fiscal, household-income and financial-balance analysis that goes beyond GDP aggregates.

reports.title: Matriz de Insumo-Producto (MIP) / Input-Output Matrix
reports.description: Symmetric input-output table produced as part of the national accounts benchmark process (aligned with Supply and Use Tables). Used for structural analysis, multiplier studies and as a foundation for satellite accounts.
reports._notes: Structural benchmark product. Referenced as a source in the construction of tourism and other satellite accounts. Updated with major base-year revisions of the SCNM.

reports.title: Censo Agropecuario / Agricultural Census
reports.description: Periodic census of agricultural, livestock and forestry activities (most recent major exercise 2022). Provides structural data on land use, production units, labour and output. Declared Information of National Interest; methodology explicitly grounded in the LSNIEG.
reports._notes: Ninth agricultural census in Mexican history. 2022 results: ~103.6 million ha with agricultural/forestry use or vocation; ~27 million people in agricultural labour force. Methodology documents open with LSNIEG legal foundation (same pattern as population and economic censuses).

reports.title: Encuesta Nacional Agropecuaria (ENA) / National Agricultural Survey
reports.description: Sample survey providing more frequent updates on agricultural producers and production between censuses. Complements the Agricultural Census with continuous monitoring of the sector.
reports._notes: Bridge survey between agricultural censuses. Results and methodology workshops are published (e.g. ENA 2025). Used for sector monitoring and policy.

reports.title: Encuesta Nacional de la Dinámica Demográfica (ENADID) / National Survey of Demographic Dynamics
reports.description: Periodic demographic survey (roughly every five years once designated Información de Interés Nacional) covering fertility, mortality, internal and international migration, reproductive preferences, contraceptive use, nuptiality, maternal-child health, and related household/housing topics. Complements the Population Census.
reports._notes: Key intercensal demographic source. Series since 1992; 2023 edition is the latest full exercise. Explicitly part of the SNIEG and used for population projections and policy design.

reports.title: Encuesta Nacional sobre Disponibilidad y Uso de Tecnologías de la Información en los Hogares (ENDUTIH)
reports.description: Household survey on availability and use of information and communication technologies (internet, computers, mobile phones, etc.). Annual or near-annual.
reports._notes: Principal source for digital-inclusion and ICT-access indicators at household level. Complements enterprise ICT surveys and is widely cited in digital-economy analysis.

reports.title: Cuentas Económicas y Ecológicas de México (CEEM) / Economic and Ecological Accounts of Mexico
reports.description: Environmental-economic accounts producing the environmentally adjusted Net Domestic Product (Producto Interno Neto Ecológico / PINE) and the total costs of resource depletion and environmental degradation (emissions, soil, untreated wastewater, solid waste, forest, groundwater, hydrocarbons).
reports._notes: 2024 results: PINE ≈ 25.7 trillion pesos (76.6% of market-price GDP); total environmental costs ≈ 1.38 trillion pesos (4.1% of GDP), dominated by air emissions. Implements SEEA-style accounting within the Mexican national-accounts framework.

reports.title: Cuenta Satélite de la Cultura de México (CSCM) / Satellite Account of Culture of Mexico
reports.description: Satellite account measuring the economic contribution of cultural activities (production, income, employment, supply and use, expenditure). Follows SNA 2008, UNESCO culture-statistics framework and Ibero-American guidance.
reports._notes: One of the suite of Mexican satellite accounts (alongside tourism, health, unpaid work, environment, non-profit, housing). Provides value-added, employment and expenditure by cultural domain and by state.

reports.title: Balanza de Pagos / Balance of Payments
reports.description: Quarterly (and annual) balance-of-payments statistics compiled by Banco de México according to international standards. Covers current account, capital account, financial account and reserves. Methodological note published by Banxico.
reports._notes: Core external-accounts product. Complements INEGI merchandise trade statistics with services, primary income, secondary income (including remittances) and financial-account flows. Regular press releases give the quarterly aggregates and ratios to GDP.

reports.title: Reservas Internacionales Netas / Net International Reserves
reports.description: Weekly (and higher-frequency) stock of Banco de México’s net international reserves. Published in the weekly balance-sheet communiqué and used as a key external-vulnerability and monetary-policy indicator.
reports._notes: High-frequency Banxico series. Levels in mid-2026 around USD 255 billion. Appears in the weekly Estado de Cuenta and in the balance-of-payments financial account (change in reserve assets).

reports.title: Tipo de cambio peso-dólar (fixación Banxico) / Peso-dollar exchange rate (Banxico fix)
reports.description: Official daily fixing of the peso/US dollar exchange rate published by Banco de México for settlement of obligations denominated in foreign currency payable in Mexico.
reports._notes: Benchmark exchange-rate series used throughout financial markets, national accounts (for conversion) and policy analysis. Published daily on business days.

reports.title: Encuesta Nacional de Vivienda (ENH) / National Housing Survey (or related continuous housing modules)
reports.description: Household survey / modules providing detailed information on housing characteristics, tenure, services and quality. Complements census housing data and feeds the housing-related deprivations in multidimensional poverty measurement.
reports._notes: Supports continuous monitoring of housing conditions between censuses and is linked to the ‘calidad y espacios de la vivienda’ and ‘servicios básicos en la vivienda’ dimensions of multidimensional poverty.

reports.title: ENIGH — Ingresos por transferencias / Transfer income (from ENIGH)
reports.description: Component of ENIGH that captures current transfers received by households (government social programmes, remittances, private transfers, etc.). Central for analysing the impact of Bienestar pensions and other social transfers on household income and poverty.
reports._notes: Direct statistical counterpart to the programme-side beneficiary counts of the Pensión para el Bienestar and related schemes. Used in distributional and poverty-impact analysis.

reports.title: Cuadros de Oferta y Utilización (COU) / Supply and Use Tables
reports.description: Annual (and benchmark) Supply and Use Tables that form the core balancing framework of the Sistema de Cuentas Nacionales de México. Source of GDP by production, expenditure and income approaches at detailed product and industry level.
reports._notes: Foundational tables from which many satellite accounts and short-term indicators are derived or benchmarked. Explicitly referenced in tourism, health and other satellite-account methodologies.

reports.title: Producto Interno Bruto Trimestral / Quarterly GDP
reports.description: Quarterly national-accounts estimates of GDP (production, expenditure and income approaches) consistent with the annual SCNM. Principal short-term macroeconomic aggregate.
reports._notes: Headline quarterly GDP series. Linked to IGAE, IMAI and the full annual accounts. Widely used by Banxico, SHCP and markets.

reports.title: Ingresos por remesas familiares / Family remittance income
reports.description: Monthly statistics of family remittances received from abroad, published by Banco de México as part of the secondary-income component of the balance of payments and as a standalone high-frequency series.
reports._notes: Major secondary-income flow and important household-income source, especially in certain states. Appears in the balance-of-payments secondary-income account and is analysed alongside ENIGH transfer income.

reports.title: Anuario Estadístico y Geográfico por Entidad Federativa / Statistical and Geographic Yearbook by Federal Entity
reports.description: Annual compendium of key statistical and geographic indicators for each federal entity, drawing together data from multiple INEGI programmes and other official sources.
reports._notes: Useful secondary product that packages state-level indicators already produced by primary programmes. Serves as a convenient entry point for entity-level analysis and is itself a published annual series.

reports.title: Censo Nacional de Gobiernos Municipales y Demarcaciones Territoriales de la Ciudad de México (CNGMD)
reports.description: Periodic census of municipal governments and Mexico City territorial demarcations covering structure, resources, public services, security, justice and other municipal functions. Primary structural source for municipal-level public administration statistics.
reports._notes: Key municipal-jurisdiction product. Complements ENCIG (user perception) with supply-side institutional data on municipal governments. Part of the broader family of National Censuses of Government.

reports.title: Censo Nacional de Impartición de Justicia Estatal (CNIJE) / National Census of State Justice Administration
reports.description: Census of state-level justice institutions (courts, related bodies). Provides structural and workload statistics for the state justice system.
reports._notes: Part of the SNIGSPIJ government/security/justice statistical subsystem. Complements ENVIPE perception and victimization data with institutional supply-side information.

reports.title: Censo Nacional de Poderes Legislativos Estatales (CNPLE)
reports.description: Census of state legislative powers covering structure, resources and legislative activity.
reports._notes: Another component of the National Censuses of Government family; supplies institutional data on state legislatures.

reports.title: Agregados monetarios y base monetaria / Monetary aggregates and monetary base
reports.description: Regular statistics of the monetary base and broader monetary aggregates published by Banco de México. Used for monetary analysis and policy assessment.
reports._notes: Core Banxico monetary statistics. Monetary base appears in the weekly balance-sheet communiqué; broader aggregates are published on a regular calendar and analysed in the quarterly reports.

reports.title: Tasas de interés de mercado (Cetes, TIIE, etc.) / Market interest rates
reports.description: Daily and periodic market interest-rate statistics (government securities yields, interbank rates, etc.) published or referenced by Banco de México. The policy rate (tasa objetivo) is the operational target; these series show transmission along the yield curve.
reports._notes: Complements the policy-rate node. Banxico and market analysis routinely track pass-through from the overnight target to Cetes, TIIE and longer yields.

reports.title: Estadísticas de crédito y vivienda Infonavit / Infonavit housing-credit statistics
reports.publisher: Instituto del Fondo Nacional de la Vivienda para los Trabajadores (Infonavit)
reports.description: Regular statistics on housing credits granted, outstanding portfolio and related housing-finance indicators from the main worker housing fund.
reports._notes: Principal administrative source for formal housing finance linked to formal employment. Complements ENH / census housing data and appears in household balance-sheet and social-policy analysis.

reports.title: Cuenta Satélite de las Instituciones sin Fines de Lucro / Satellite Account of Non-Profit Institutions
reports.description: Satellite account measuring the economic contribution of non-profit institutions serving households within the national-accounts framework.
reports._notes: One of the standard suite of Mexican satellite accounts (with tourism, health, culture, unpaid work, environment). Completes the institutional coverage of the SCNM.

reports.title: Estadísticas de Defunciones Registradas (EDR) / Registered Death Statistics
reports.description: Vital statistics of registered deaths compiled from civil-registration sources. Published with regular bulletins and used for mortality analysis and demographic estimation.
reports._notes: Core civil-registration-based mortality series. Complements ENADID and census data for demographic analysis and is published on the regular INEGI calendar.

reports.title: Estadísticas de Nacimientos / Birth Statistics
reports.description: Vital statistics of registered births. Companion series to death statistics within the vital-registration system.
reports._notes: Completes the core vital-statistics pair with deaths. Used with ENADID and census data for fertility and population estimation.

reports.title: Encuesta Mensual de Opinión Empresarial (EMOE) / Monthly Business Opinion Survey
reports.description: Monthly qualitative survey of business expectations and assessments in manufacturing, construction and other sectors. Provides diffusion indices and confidence indicators.
reports._notes: Soft short-term indicator that complements the hard quantitative surveys (EMIM, EMEC, EMS, ENEC). Used in cyclical analysis alongside Banxico and private-sector confidence measures.

reports.title: IGAE por actividad económica / Global Indicator of Economic Activity by activity
reports.description: Detailed activity breakdown of the monthly Global Indicator of Economic Activity (primary, secondary, tertiary and selected sub-activities).
reports._notes: More granular view of the headline IGAE already listed. Useful as a distinct analytical product even though it is derived from the same underlying framework.

reports.title: Estadísticas de finanzas públicas federales (SHCP) / Federal public-finance statistics
reports.publisher: Secretaría de Hacienda y Crédito Público (SHCP)
reports.description: Monthly and quarterly federal government revenue, expenditure, balance and debt statistics published by the Ministry of Finance. Complements the INEGI state/municipal public-finance series (EFIPEM).
reports._notes: Primary federal fiscal series. Used with Banxico and INEGI data for overall public-sector analysis and is the natural counterpart to EFIPEM at the federal level.

reports.title: Censo Nacional de Procuración de Justicia Estatal (CNPJE) / National Census of State Prosecution
reports.description: Annual census of the Fiscalías / Procuradurías Generales de Justicia of the 32 federal entities. Covers structure, resources, investigation files (carpetas de investigación), determinations, alternative dispute resolution, and forensic services. Designated Información de Interés Nacional; continuous annual series.
reports._notes: Core prosecution-side counterpart to the impartición (courts) censuses. 2025 results covering 2024: ~2.14 million investigation files opened nationally (96.3% by state fiscalías). Estado de México, CDMX and Guanajuato account for large shares. Completes the justice-system statistical triangle with ENVIPE (victimization) and CNIJE (courts).

reports.title: Censo Nacional de Procuración de Justicia Federal (CNPJF) / National Census of Federal Prosecution
reports.description: Annual census of the Fiscalía General de la República (FGR). Parallel product to the state prosecution census; covers federal investigation activity, structure and resources.
reports._notes: Federal leg of the prosecution censuses. Together with CNPJE it provides the full picture of public prosecution in Mexico. Published in coordinated CNPJF-E releases.

reports.title: Censo Nacional de Impartición de Justicia Federal (CNIJF) / National Census of Federal Justice Administration
reports.description: Annual census of the federal judiciary (SCJN, electoral tribunal, circuit and district courts under the CJF, agrarian tribunals). Covers structure, caseload, resources and related functions. Complements the state impartición census (CNIJE).
reports._notes: Clarifies the federal courts node previously bundled with the state one. 2025 results include SCJN caseload (e.g. ~16 370 jurisdictional matters in 2024), amparo volumes in circuit and district courts, and overall federal + state judicial budget and staffing figures.

reports.title: Anuario Estadístico e Indicadores de Derechos Humanos del Poder Judicial de la Ciudad de México
reports.publisher: Poder Judicial de la Ciudad de México (PJCDMX)
reports.description: Annual statistical yearbook of the CDMX judiciary. Tracks caseload (filings, sentences, hearings, agreements), resources, processing times and a large set of human-rights / fair-trial indicators. Continuous series (15+ editions).
reports._notes: Strong local judicial product. 2024 edition contains 284 indicators with historical series. Also publishes higher-frequency ‘Justicia en cifras’ snapshots. Direct municipal/state-level justice node for the capital.

reports.title: CNGMD — Demarcaciones territoriales (alcaldías) de la Ciudad de México
reports.description: Component of the Censo Nacional de Gobiernos Municipales y Demarcaciones Territoriales focused on the 16 alcaldías of CDMX. Covers integration of the alcaldía councils, human/material/budgetary resources, and performance in government, public security, civil protection, civic justice, water/sanitation and solid waste.
reports._notes: Primary structural source for the 16 alcaldías. Biennial. Treats alcaldías as the municipal-level unit for CDMX. Essential for any zoom into Iztapalapa, Gustavo A. Madero, Álvaro Obregón, etc.

reports.title: Sistema de Indicadores de la Ciudad de México (SI CDMX) / IPDP indicator system
reports.publisher: Instituto de Planeación Democrática y Prospectiva (IPDP) de la Ciudad de México
reports.description: Public indicator platform maintained by the CDMX planning institute. Hosts development, programme and rights indicators for the city and its alcaldías, linked to the local planning system and government programmes.
reports._notes: Local monitoring system mandated by the CDMX Constitution and Planning Law. Provides a city-level and alcaldía-level dashboard layer that re-uses and presents official statistics for policy tracking.

reports.title: Evalúa CDMX — evaluaciones y mediciones de política social
reports.publisher: Consejo de Evaluación del Desarrollo Social de la Ciudad de México (Evalúa CDMX)
reports.description: Evaluation body that produces assessments and social-development measurements for CDMX programmes and conditions (including social-development indices at fine geographic scales).
reports._notes: City-level analogue to the former CONEVAL function. Produces and uses fine-grained social indicators (e.g. Índice de Desarrollo Social at block level) that complement national multidimensional poverty statistics for the capital.

reports.title: Alcaldía Iztapalapa — statistical and administrative profile
reports.publisher: Alcaldía Iztapalapa / INEGI (via CNGMD, census, DENUE, etc.)
reports.description: Largest alcaldía by population (~1.8 million in 2020). Profile assembled from national census, CNGMD, DENUE, local government reporting and city indicator systems. Serves as the first deep municipal zoom node.
reports._notes: Prototype lowest-level node. Iztapalapa is the most populous demarcation. Most of its statistical identity comes from national programmes disaggregated to alcaldía level plus the CNGMD structural data. Qualifies under the expanded rule via continuous citation in city and national statistical products and in local planning documents.
_referenced_by: Censo de Población y Vivienda (alcaldía tabulations)

reports.title: Alcaldía Gustavo A. Madero — statistical and administrative profile
reports.region: Ciudad de México — Gustavo A. Madero
reports.description: Second-tier large alcaldía by population. Same data architecture as Iztapalapa (census, CNGMD, DENUE, city indicators, local administration).
reports._notes: Second deep municipal zoom example within CDMX. Establishes the pattern for other large alcaldías if needed later.
